_notes: trackerTypes was rewritten in Phase 5 to match the labels actually shipped on the institute pages (Phase 3/4) rather than the original generic Phase 1 placeholder list, which had drifted out of sync with real usage. Each type's id is the URL-safe slug used in track.html?org=X&tracker=Y. No live tracker instances (specific institute+type+status records) exist yet — that's the tracking engine, still a future phase. Every tracker page must render 'Not officially released yet' rather than guessing a status when real data isn't present.
